title: A Quick Primer on ADRs and SKHY
summary: I started my career as a foreign equity arbitrageur. In those dark ages, when trading was done over the phone and brokerage firms rarely offered direct access to international markets, an institutional trader could seek opportunities where there was a minor mispricing between ordinary shares traded in local markets and their ADR counterparts in the US. Even then, those divergences were fleeting, and more efficient markets made them even rarer. Yet one giant exception is occurring in plain sight: SK Hynix ADRs (SKHY) are trading at a significant premium to local shares.
